name: VMware Certified Design Expert - Data Center Virtualization
name_ja: VMware認定デザインエキスパート（データセンター仮想化）

logistics.format: Design defense before VCDX panel: 75-min defense of submitted design + 45-min design scenario + 15-min troubleshooting

formal: Hold a current VCAP-DCV Design certification (2021-2024 cohort accepted)
Submit a complete design package addressing all areas of the VCDX-DCV blueprint
Application accepted by VCDX program before defense is scheduled

recommended_certs.rationale: VCIX (VCAP Design + Deploy) demonstrates the implementation depth assumed by the VCDX panel.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded seven-year profile, submitted real design and panel defense substantiate expert architecture decisions; virtualization focus and English-only assessment limit its direct security-specific and local accessibility signals.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A submitted design, panel defense and live design/troubleshooting scenarios with seven years of experience strongly support expert infrastructure architecture. Vendor concentration and general infrastructure scope limit direct claims about cybersecurity execution.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded real design submission, panel defense and live design and troubleshooting scenarios demonstrate architecture judgment at seven years. This supports expert infrastructure design while remaining VMware-specific rather than a general security credential.
